decisions.decision: Sampler and SPU-94 are separate products connected at audio level
decisions.rationale: Anthony wants them to feel like two independent codebases wired together like analog hardware

decisions.rationale: Simpler for now; per-voice routing deferred

decisions.decision: Mixer sections: ADPCM (Input ADPCM Level + Sampler Level) / Dry / Reverb
decisions.rationale: Groups controls by sound character — PSX crunchy vs clean vs wet

decisions.decision: Voice Rate renamed to Input Rate
decisions.rationale: It controls the live input sample rate, not the sampler voices
